sections.h2: Deep Creek Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 139 residential sales closed in Deep Creek (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $410,000, close to the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 23 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Deep Creek sales closed between $324,000 and $478,000, or about $216 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($410,000, 71 sales) was about 1% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($407,500, 68 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Deep Creek
sections.html:
93% of the sales were detached homes and 7% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,856 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,514 to 2,351 square feet. 40% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Home ages vary widely here: about 80% of sales were built between 1950 and 2022, with a median year built of 1989.

Averages hide a lot, so Chris Jenkins compares you to homes that match yours on street, size, age and condition rather than to the whole Deep Creek median.

Because Virginia sellers give a disclosure statement that tells buyers to do their own due diligence, read our guide to the Virginia Residential Property Disclosure Statement.
